steps.message:
Generate a single data visualization chart that effectively conveys the insight described in the goal (see `goal[]` in task_input.json). You must choose the most appropriate chart type and visual encoding to tell the story — the goal does not specify chart type.

**Quality requirements**:
- Include title, axis labels, legend, and units as appropriate
- Professional color scheme suitable for the target audience (see `style` field in task_input.json)
- All data must be traceable to source_data.json — do not fabricate data

Only the correctly saved final file is needed — no additional explanation is required.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for the visualization goal, style, and evaluation checkpoints.
2. Read `/app/benchmark/source_data.json` for the datasets to visualize.
3. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for dataset documentation and field descriptions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output the final chart to `/app/output/result.png`.
2. The chart must be a single self-contained PNG image file.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — do not pause, ask questions, or wait for a reply. When encountering BLOCKING or "wait for user confirmation" instructions, make a professional judgment and proceed.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies a `style` field, use it to guide color schemes, layout, and design choices; otherwise, use your professional judgment.
3. **Priority** — these rules take precedence over any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The workflow, quality standards, and technical specifications in SKILL.md remain in effect; only interactive waits are skipped.

# Global Disease Burden Transition: 1990 vs 2024 DALY Comparison

## Overview
This collection of datasets captures the global epidemiological transition between 1990 and 2024, covering top causes of disability-adjusted life years (DALYs), disease burden composition by World Bank income group, and aggregate category totals.

## Data Source

### top10_daly_causes
Contains 20 rows (10 per year). Fields: `year` (1990 or 2024), `rank` (1–10), `cause` (disease/condition name, string), `dalys_millions` (float, millions of DALYs), `category` (one of: Communicable, NCD, Injury). Represents the top 10 global DALY causes for each reference year.

### daly_by_income_group
Contains 8 rows (4 income groups × 2 years). Fields: `year`, `income_group` (Low income, Lower-middle income, Upper-middle income, High income), `communicable_pct`, `ncd_pct`, `injury_pct` — each a float summing to approximately 100% per row. Represents percentage share of total DALYs by disease category within each income group.

### global_category_totals
Contains 6 rows (3 categories × 2 years). Fields: `year`, `category` (Communicable, NCD, Injury), `dalys_millions` (float). Represents aggregate global DALYs by broad disease category.

## Data Notes
- DALY estimates are modeled based on GBD-style methodology; 2024 figures are projected estimates.
- Communicable category includes maternal, neonatal, and nutritional conditions per GBD convention.
- Percentages may not sum to exactly 100% due to rounding.

import json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

with open('/app/benchmark/task_input.json') as f:
    task = json.load(f)
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Color scheme: editorial/research audience
COLORS = {
    'Communicable': '#E15759',
    'NCD': '#4E79A7',
    'Injury': '#F28E2B'
}

CATEGORY_LABELS = {
    'Communicable': 'Communicable\n(maternal, neonatal, nutritional)',
    'NCD': 'Non-Communicable Disease',
    'Injury': 'Injury'
}

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 4, figsize=(20, 8))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')

# ── Panel 1: Stacked bar – global category totals ──────────────────────────
ax1 = axes[0]
ax1.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')
categories = ['Communicable', 'NCD', 'Injury']
width = 0.5
x = np.array([0])
vals_1990 = [1128.4, 768.2, 253.7]
vals_2024 = [612.5, 1487.3, 308.6]
bottom_1990 = 0
bottom_2024 = 0
for cat, col in COLORS.items():
    idx = categories.index(cat)
    h1990 = vals_1990[idx]
    h2024 = vals_2024[idx]
    ax1.bar(x - 0.2, h1990, width, bottom=bottom_1990, color=col, label=cat)
    ax1.bar(x + 0.2, h2024, width, bottom=bottom_2024, color=col, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    bottom_1990 += h1990
    bottom_2024 += h2024

ax1.set_xlim(-0.7, 0.7)
ax1.set_xticks([-0.2, 0.2])
ax1.set_xticklabels(['1990', '2024'])
ax1.set_ylabel('DALYs (millions)')
ax1.set_title('Global DALYs by Category\n(1990 vs 2024)', fontweight='bold', fontsize=11)
ax1.yaxis.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.4)
ax1.set_axisbelow(True)

patches = [mpatches.Patch(color=COLORS[c], label=CATEGORY_LABELS.get(c, c)) for c in categories]
ax1.legend(handles=patches, fontsize=7, loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9)

# ── Panel 2: Diverging bar chart – top 10 rank changes ────────────────────
ax2 = axes[1]
ax2.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')

causes_1990 = [
    ('Lower respiratory infections', 1, 178.5, 'Communicable'),
    ('Diarrheal diseases', 2, 155.2, 'Communicable'),
    ('Neonatal preterm birth', 3, 103.8, 'Communicable'),
    ('Ischemic heart disease', 4, 98.6, 'NCD'),
    ('Stroke', 5, 82.4, 'NCD'),
    ('Malaria', 6, 78.1, 'Communicable'),
    ('Tuberculosis', 7, 72.3, 'Communicable'),
    ('Measles', 8, 65.9, 'Communicable'),
    ('COPD', 9, 57.2, 'NCD'),
    ('Road injuries', 10, 52.7, 'Injury'),
]
causes_2024 = [
    ('Ischemic heart disease', 1, 192.3, 'NCD'),
    ('Stroke', 2, 147.8, 'NCD'),
    ('Diabetes mellitus', 3, 118.4, 'NCD'),
    ('COPD', 4, 105.1, 'NCD'),
    ('Neonatal preterm birth', 5, 82.6, 'Communicable'),
    ('Lower respiratory infections', 6, 78.3, 'Communicable'),
    ('Low back pain', 7, 74.9, 'NCD'),
    ('Depressive disorders', 8, 68.5, 'NCD'),
    ('Road injuries', 9, 63.2, 'Injury'),
    ('Lung cancer', 10, 58.7, 'NCD'),
]

rank_change = {}
for cause, rank, dalys, cat in causes_1990:
    rank_change[cause] = {'old_rank': rank, 'cat': cat}
for cause, rank, dalys, cat in causes_2024:
    if cause in rank_change:
        rank_change[cause]['new_rank'] = rank
    else:
        rank_change[cause] = {'old_rank': None, 'new_rank': rank, 'cat': cat}

common = sorted(
    [(c, d['old_rank'], d['new_rank'], d['cat']) for c, d in rank_change.items() if d['old_rank'] and d['new_rank']],
    key=lambda x: x[2]
)
common_labels = [x[0] for x in common]
common_old = [x[1] for x in common]
common_new = [x[2] for x in common]

import json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    raw = json.load(f)

# Unwrap nested structure: each dataset has {description, unit, data: [...]}
def unwrap(d): return d['data']

COLORS = {
    'Communicable': '#E15759',
    'NCD': '#4E79A7',
    'Injury': '#F28E2B'
}

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 4, figsize=(20, 8))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')

# ── Panel 1: Stacked bar – global category totals ──────────────────────────
ax1 = axes[0]
ax1.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')
categories = ['Communicable', 'NCD', 'Injury']
x = np.array([0])
vals_1990 = [1128.4, 768.2, 253.7]
vals_2024 = [612.5, 1487.3, 308.6]
bottom_1990 = 0
bottom_2024 = 0
for cat in categories:
    col = COLORS[cat]
    idx = categories.index(cat)
    h1990 = vals_1990[idx]
    h2024 = vals_2024[idx]
    ax1.bar(x - 0.2, h1990, 0.5, bottom=bottom_1990, color=col, label=cat)
    ax1.bar(x + 0.2, h2024, 0.5, bottom=bottom_2024, color=col, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    bottom_1990 += h1990
    bottom_2024 += h2024

ax1.set_xlim(-0.7, 0.7)
ax1.set_xticks([-0.2, 0.2])
ax1.set_xticklabels(['1990', '2024'])
ax1.set_ylabel('DALYs (millions)')
ax1.set_title('Global DALYs by Category\n(1990 vs 2024)', fontweight='bold', fontsize=11)
ax1.yaxis.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.4)
ax1.set_axisbelow(True)

patches = [mpatches.Patch(color=COLORS[c], label=c) for c in categories]
ax1.legend(handles=patches, fontsize=7, loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9)

# ── Panel 2: Diverging bar – rank changes of common top-10 causes ────────────────────
ax2 = axes[1]
ax2.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')

causes_1990 = [
    ('Lower respiratory infections', 1, 178.5, 'Communicable'),
    ('Diarrheal diseases', 2, 155.2, 'Communicable'),
    ('Neonatal preterm birth', 3, 103.8, 'Communicable'),
    ('Ischemic heart disease', 4, 98.6, 'NCD'),
    ('Stroke', 5, 82.4, 'NCD'),
    ('Malaria', 6, 78.1, 'Communicable'),
    ('Tuberculosis', 7, 72.3, 'Communicable'),
    ('Measles', 8, 65.9, 'Communicable'),
    ('COPD', 9, 57.2, 'NCD'),
    ('Road injuries', 10, 52.7, 'Injury'),
]
causes_2024 = [
    ('Ischemic heart disease', 1, 192.3, 'NCD'),
    ('Stroke', 2, 147.8, 'NCD'),
    ('Diabetes mellitus', 3, 118.4, 'NCD'),
    ('COPD', 4, 105.1, 'NCD'),
    ('Neonatal preterm birth', 5, 82.6, 'Communicable'),
    ('Lower respiratory infections', 6, 78.3, 'Communicable'),
    ('Low back pain', 7, 74.9, 'NCD'),
    ('Depressive disorders', 8, 68.5, 'NCD'),
    ('Road injuries', 9, 63.2, 'Injury'),
    ('Lung cancer', 10, 58.7, 'NCD'),
]

rank_1990 = {c: r for c, r, d, k in causes_1990}
rank_2024 = {c: r for c, r, d, k in causes_2024}
all_common = [c for c in rank_1990 if c in rank_2024]
common_sorted = sorted(all_common, key=lambda c: rank_2024[c])

labels = common_sorted
change_vals = [rank_1990[c] - rank_2024[c] for c in labels]
cat_lookup = {c: k for c, r, d, k in causes_1990}
cat_lookup.update({c: k for c, r, d, k in causes_2024})
colors_bar = [COLORS[cat_lookup[c]] for c in labels]

y_pos = np.arange(len(labels))
bars = ax2.barh(y_pos, change_vals, color=colors_bar, height=0.6)
ax2.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax2.set_yticklabels(labels, fontsize=8)
ax2.axvline(0, color='black', linewidth=0.8)
ax2.set_xlabel('Rank change  (← worse | better →)')
ax2.set_title('Rank Change: Common Top-10 Causes\n(1990 rank − 2024 rank)', fontweight='bold', fontsize=11)
ax2.yaxis.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.3)
ax2.set_axisbelow(True)
ax2.set_ylim(-0.5, len(labels) - 0.5)

for bar, val in zip(bars, change_vals):
    x_pos = val + 0.08 if val >= 0 else val - 0.08
    ax2.text(x_pos, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{val:+.0f}',
             va='center', ha='left' if val >= 0 else 'right', fontsize=7, color='#333333')

# ── Panel 3: Stacked % bar – income group composition ───────────────────────
ax3 = axes[2]
ax3.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')

income_records = unwrap(raw['daly_by_income_group'])
recs_1990 = [r for r in income_records if r['year'] == 1990]
recs_2024 = [r for r in income_records if r['year'] == 2024]

income_groups = ['Low income', 'Lower-middle income', 'Upper-middle income', 'High income']
x3 = np.arange(len(income_groups))
bar_w = 0.18

pct_keys = {
    'Communicable': 'communicable_pct',
    'NCD': 'ncd_pct',
    'Injury': 'injury_pct'
}

for i in range(len(income_groups)):
    base = 0
    for cat in ['Communicable', 'NCD', 'Injury']:
        key = pct_keys[cat]
        pct90 = recs_1990[i][key]
        pct24 = recs_2024[i][key]
        ax3.bar(i - 0.2, pct90, bar_w, bottom=base, color=COLORS[cat])
        ax3.bar(i + 0.2, pct24, bar_w, bottom=base, color=COLORS[cat], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
        base += pct90

ax3.set_xticks(x3)
ax3.set_xticklabels(income_groups, fontsize=8)
ax3.set_ylabel('Share of total DALYs (%)')
ax3.set_title('DALY Composition by\nIncome Group', fontweight='bold', fontsize=11)
ax3.yaxis.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.4)
ax3.set_axisbelow(True)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 108)

rects = [mpatches.Patch(color=COLORS[c], label=c) for c in categories]
ax3.legend(handles=rects, fontsize=7, loc='upper right', framealpha=0.9)

for i in range(len(income_groups)):
    ax3.text(i - 0.2, -5, '1990', ha='center', fontsize=7, color='#888888')
    ax3.text(i + 0.2, -5, '2024', ha='center', fontsize=7, color='#888888')

# ── Panel 4: Slope chart – NCD % share by income group ────────────────────
ax4 = axes[3]
ax4.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')

ig_labels = ['Low\nincome', 'Lower-\nmiddle', 'Upper-\nmiddle', 'High\nincome']
ig_colors = ['#B07AA1', '#EDC948', '#59A14F', '#E15759']
pct_ncd_1990 = [19.8, 36.1, 57.3, 81.6]
pct_ncd_2024 = [37.4, 60.5, 77.2, 87.8]

for i, (label, col_ig) in enumerate(zip(ig_labels, ig_colors)):
    ax4.plot([0, 1], [pct_ncd_1990[i], pct_ncd_2024[i]], 'o-', color=col_ig, linewidth=2.5, markersize=7)
    ax4.text(-0.12, pct_ncd_1990[i], f'{pct_ncd_1990[i]:.1f}%', ha='right', va='center', fontsize=8)
    ax4.text(1.12, pct_ncd_2024[i], f'{pct_ncd_2024[i]:.1f}%', ha='left', va='center', fontsize=8)

ax4.set_xlim(-0.5, 1.5)
ax4.set_xticks([0, 1])
ax4.set_xticklabels(['1990', '2024'])
ax4.set_ylabel('NCD share of total DALYs (%)')
ax4.set_title('NCD Share Trend by\nIncome Group (1990–2024)', fontweight='bold', fontsize=11)
ax4.yaxis.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.4)
ax4.set_axisbelow(True)
ax4.legend(ig_labels, fontsize=7, loc='lower right', framealpha=0.9, title='Income group')

# ── Global title ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.suptitle('The Global Epidemiological Transition: From Communicable to Chronic Disease',
             fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', y=0.98, color='#1A1A2E')

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.95])
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor=fig.get_facecolor())
plt.close()
print("Saved /app/output/result.png")

    col = COLORS[cat]
    idx = categories.index(cat)
    h1990 = vals_1990[idx]
    h2024 = vals_2024[idx]
    ax1.bar(x - 0.2, h1990, 0.5, bottom=bottom_1990, color=col, label=cat)
    ax1.bar(x + 0.2, h2024, 0.5, bottom=bottom_2024, color=col, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    bottom_1990 += h1990
    bottom_2024 += h2024

ax1.set_xlim(-0.7, 0.7)
ax1.set_xticks([-0.2, 0.2])
ax1.set_xticklabels(['1990', '2024'])
ax1.set_ylabel('DALYs (millions)')
ax1.set_title('Global DALYs by Category\n(1990 vs 2024)', fontweight='bold', fontsize=11)
ax1.yaxis.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.4)
ax1.set_axisbelow(True)

patches = [mpatches.Patch(color=COLORS[c], label=c) for c in categories]
ax1.legend(handles=patches, fontsize=7, loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9)

# ── Panel 2: Diverging bar – rank changes of common top-10 causes ────────────────────
ax2 = axes[1]
ax2.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')

causes_1990 = [
    ('Lower respiratory infections', 1, 178.5, 'Communicable'),
    ('Diarrheal diseases', 2, 155.2, 'Communicable'),
    ('Neonatal preterm birth', 3, 103.8, 'Communicable'),
    ('Ischemic heart disease', 4, 98.6, 'NCD'),
    ('Stroke', 5, 82.4, 'NCD'),
    ('Malaria', 6, 78.1, 'Communicable'),
    ('Tuberculosis', 7, 72.3, 'Communicable'),
    ('Measles', 8, 65.9, 'Communicable'),
    ('COPD', 9, 57.2, 'NCD'),
    ('Road injuries', 10, 52.7, 'Injury'),
]
causes_2024 = [
    ('Ischemic heart disease', 1, 192.3, 'NCD'),
    ('Stroke', 2, 147.8, 'NCD'),
    ('Diabetes mellitus', 3, 118.4, 'NCD'),
    ('COPD', 4, 105.1, 'NCD'),
    ('Neonatal preterm birth', 5, 82.6, 'Communicable'),
    ('Lower respiratory infections', 6, 78.3, 'Communicable'),
    ('Low back pain', 7, 74.9, 'NCD'),
    ('Depressive disorders', 8, 68.5, 'NCD'),
    ('Road injuries', 9, 63.2, 'Injury'),
    ('Lung cancer', 10, 58.7, 'NCD'),
]

rank_1990 = {c: r for c, r, d, k in causes_1990}
rank_2024 = {c: r for c, r, d, k in causes_2024}
all_common = [c for c in rank_1990 if c in rank_2024]
common_sorted = sorted(all_common, key=lambda c: rank_2024[c])

labels = common_sorted
change_vals = [rank_1990[c] - rank_2024[c] for c in labels]
cat_lookup = {c: k for c, r, d, k in causes_1990}
cat_lookup.update({c: k for c, r, d, k in causes_2024})
colors_bar = [COLORS[cat_lookup[c]] for c in labels]

y_pos = np.arange(len(labels))
bars = ax2.barh(y_pos, change_vals, color=colors_bar, height=0.6)
ax2.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax2.set_yticklabels(labels, fontsize=8)
ax2.axvline(0, color='black', linewidth=0.8)
ax2.set_xlabel('Rank change  (← worse | better →)')
ax2.set_title('Rank Change: Common Top-10 Causes\n(1990 rank − 2024 rank)', fontweight='bold', fontsize=11)
ax2.yaxis.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.3)
ax2.set_axisbelow(True)
ax2.set_ylim(-0.5, len(labels) - 0.5)

for bar, val in zip(bars, change_vals):
    x_pos = val + 0.08 if val >= 0 else val - 0.08
    ax2.text(x_pos, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{val:+.0f}',
             va='center', ha='left' if val >= 0 else 'right', fontsize=7, color='#333333')

# ── Panel 3: Stacked % bar – income group composition ───────────────────────
ax3 = axes[2]
ax3.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')

income_records = unwrap(raw['daly_by_income_group'])
recs_1990 = [r for r in income_records if r['year'] == 1990]
recs_2024 = [r for r in income_records if r['year'] == 2024]

income_groups = ['Low income', 'Lower-middle income', 'Upper-middle income', 'High income']
x3 = np.arange(len(income_groups))
bar_w = 0.18

pct_keys = {
    'Communicable': 'communicable_pct',
    'NCD': 'ncd_pct',
    'Injury': 'injury_pct'
}

for i in range(len(income_groups)):
    base = 0
    for cat in ['Communicable', 'NCD', 'Injury']:
        key = pct_keys[cat]
        pct90 = recs_1990[i][key]
        pct24 = recs_2024[i][key]
        ax3.bar(i - 0.2, pct90, bar_w, bottom=base, color=COLORS[cat])
        ax3.bar(i + 0.2, pct24, bar_w, bottom=base, color=COLORS[cat], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
        base += pct90

ax3.set_xticks(x3)
ax3.set_xticklabels(income_groups, fontsize=8)
ax3.set_ylabel('Share of total DALYs (%)')
ax3.set_title('DALY Composition by\nIncome Group', fontweight='bold', fontsize=11)
ax3.yaxis.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.4)
ax3.set_axisbelow(True)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 108)

rects = [mpatches.Patch(color=COLORS[c], label=c) for c in categories]
ax3.legend(handles=rects, fontsize=7, loc='upper right', framealpha=0.9)

for i in range(len(income_groups)):
    ax3.text(i - 0.2, -5, '1990', ha='center', fontsize=7, color='#888888')
    ax3.text(i + 0.2, -5, '2024', ha='center', fontsize=7, color='#888888')

# ── Panel 4: Slope chart – NCD % share by income group ────────────────────
ax4 = axes[3]
ax4.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')

ig_labels = ['Low\nincome', 'Lower-\nmiddle', 'Upper-\nmiddle', 'High\nincome']
ig_colors = ['#B07AA1', '#EDC948', '#59A14F', '#E15759']
pct_ncd_1990 = [19.8, 36.1, 57.3, 81.6]
pct_ncd_2024 = [37.4, 60.5, 77.2, 87.8]

for i, (label, col_ig) in enumerate(zip(ig_labels, ig_colors)):
    ax4.plot([0, 1], [pct_ncd_1990[i], pct_ncd_2024[i]], 'o-', color=col_ig, linewidth=2.5, markersize=7)
    ax4.text(-0.12, pct_ncd_1990[i], f'{pct_ncd_1990[i]:.1f}%', ha='right', va='center', fontsize=8)
    ax4.text(1.12, pct_ncd_2024[i], f'{pct_ncd_2024[i]:.1f}%', ha='left', va='center', fontsize=8)

ax4.set_xlim(-0.5, 1.5)
ax4.set_xticks([0, 1])
ax4.set_xticklabels(['1990', '2024'])
ax4.set_ylabel('NCD share of total DALYs (%)')
ax4.set_title('NCD Share Trend by\nIncome Group (1990–2024)', fontweight='bold', fontsize=11)
ax4.yaxis.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.4)
ax4.set_axisbelow(True)
ax4.legend(ig_labels, fontsize=7, loc='lower right', framealpha=0.9, title='Income group')

# ── Global title ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.suptitle('The Global Epidemiological Transition: From Communicable to Chronic Disease',
             fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', y=0.98, color='#1A1A2E')

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.95])
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor=fig.get_facecolor())
plt.close()
print("Saved /app/output/result.png")
